name: 2 stars at the café: shut on a Sunday, which the profile says is a closed day
source: test review (Reputation now reads opening hours)

review.text: Came by on Sunday morning for a cardamom latte and the place was shut. Really annoying, it was the whole reason we came out.

fields.name: Cardamom Corner Café
fields.sign_off_name: Maya and the Cardamom Corner team
fields.tone_notes: Gentle, cosy and neighbourly, like a favourite local café. Calm, unhurried sentences; warm but never gushing. Use the customer's first name. Mention the bakes and the cardamom latte when it fits. Never pushy. On bad reviews: thank them for the honesty, apologise simply, and invite them back to try again.
fields.halal_statement: Our chicken is halal. We don't serve pork or alcohol.
fields.allergen_statement: Our bakes contain nuts, gluten, eggs and dairy. Please ask before you order.
recovery_offers: A free cake with your next coffee

content.text: Thank you for being honest, Rhys, and we're sorry your trip for a cardamom latte ended in a closed door. We're closed on Sundays, so we know that was a disappointing way to start your morning. We're open on Saturdays from 8:30am and on weekdays from 7:30am, and we'd love to make you that latte then. If you'd like to talk it through, please email hello@cardamomcorner.co.uk. Maya and the Cardamom Corner team
